name: pakistan-open-data-mcp
description: Search and retrieve real datasets from Pakistan's National Open Data Portal (opendata.com.pk) - over 1,500 government and research datasets across health, education, economy, and more.

tools.name: search_open_data
tools.description: Search Pakistan's National Open Data Portal for datasets matching a keyword. Returns matching datasets with title, description, publishing organization, and available formats.

tools.name: get_dataset_info
tools.description: Get full details of one specific dataset from Pakistan's Open Data Portal, including its description, publishing organization, last updated date, and downloadable files with direct URLs.

tools.name: browse_open_data_by_category
tools.description: Browse datasets on Pakistan's Open Data Portal by category, such as health, education, economy, trade, employment, or population.

tools.name: get_download_links
tools.description: Get direct download URLs for a specific dataset's data files, given its dataset name/id.
